data.summary_en: ReTerm learns recovery from its own failed tasks, builds ReTerm-10K for SFT cold start, and proposes ReTerm-GRPO, an online reinforcement learning algorithm forking from failure states into multiple independent self-recovery attempts. Qwen3.5-9B-based ReTerm-9B reaches 34.8% Pass@1 on Terminal-Bench 2.0, 14.6 points above the base model.
